description: Customer-facing clickable paper-menu style surface built from active structured catalog items.

public_catalog.function: Shows a paper-menu style customer surface with clickable regions that map to active catalog items and post ordinary order requests to the node.
public_catalog.data_access_summary: Active item ids, names, descriptions, prices, and categories only. It does not own photos, OCR, prices, inventory, payment, or operator data.
public_catalog.operator_status: available as the pilot-node photo map menu route when enabled
